name: GroceryHelper
description: Service-provider agent that handles service request requests. Declares all four protocol extensions; respects guardian routing for principally principals.

extensions.description: ACAP: requests consent before any action.
Phala: emits welfare feedback after each delivery.
NERVE: publishes behavioral fingerprint for integrity verification.
PACE: adapts interaction modality to the principal's PCP.

skills.name: Deliver groceries
skills.description: Accepts service requests and arranges delivery, gated on guardian consent.

skills.name: Request consent for delivery
skills.description: Initiates a consent request that may route through the principal's guardian.
